simple.meaning: רוּק (rûwq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Psalms, Ecclesiastes, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 14:14. Its contexts include birth, family, land.

definitions.short: to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty

occurrences.englishText: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.
As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder.
I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
You have delivered me from the strivings of the people.
Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me.
If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth;
For the fool will speak folly,
“Moab has been at ease from his youth,
Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh,

A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.
I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you,
He and his people with him,
Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts, that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be room enough for.
